capabilities: Render CleanShot share URLs as inline images in Reading view
Fetch fresh signed image URLs at render time via a MarkdownPostProcessor
Cache fetched URLs in memory to avoid refetching on re-renders
Fall back to a clickable link when the fetch fails
extras: Desktop only — the requestUrl CORS bypass is not available on mobile. Images are never saved to the vault, so there is no impact on Obsidian Sync storage.
motivation: Downloading images locally would waste Obsidian Sync storage quota, so the author renders them remotely without storing files in the vault.
problem: CleanShot share URLs point to a landing page rather than a direct image, and the underlying signed image URLs expire, so pasted links never display as pictures in notes.
